ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)

channels.name: CLK
channels.purpose: Synchronous bus clock; 0-25 MHz (Default), 0-50 MHz (High Speed), up to 208 MHz (UHS-I SDR104).
channels.active_levels: VIH ≥ 0.625 × VDD, VIL ≤ 0.25 × VDD (3.3 V); 1.8 V thresholds for UHS-I
channels.idle_level: Implementation-defined; host may gate CLK between transactions (not in UHS-II)

channels.name: CMD
channels.purpose: Command/response line; 48-bit frames; open-drain during identification, push-pull thereafter.

channels.name: DAT0
channels.purpose: Data line 0; used in 1-bit and 4-bit mode; SPI DO. Also signals BUSY (LOW) during card programming.

channels.name: DAT1
channels.purpose: Data line 1 in 4-bit mode; SDIO IRQ in SDIO mode.

channels.name: DAT2
channels.purpose: Data line 2 in 4-bit mode; SDIO Read Wait.

channels.name: DAT3 / CD / CS
channels.purpose: Data line 3 in 4-bit SD mode; CS (active LOW) in SPI mode; CD/DAT3 with on-card 50 kΩ pull-up (default enabled, disabled by ACMD42) used as card-detect sense.
channels.idle_level: HIGH via card-internal 50 kΩ pull-up (SD); host-driven (SPI)

power_pins.name: VDD
power_pins.purpose: Supply: 2.7-3.6 V (HVR) or 1.65-1.95 V (LVR / UHS-I after CMD11).

ordering_rules.byte_ordering_on_cmd: MSB-first on CMD line for cmd index, argument, CRC7.
ordering_rules.byte_ordering_on_dat_1bit: MSB-first per byte; sequential bytes streamed.
ordering_rules.byte_ordering_on_dat_4bit: Nibble-interleaved across DAT0..DAT3: byte 0 high nibble on DAT3:DAT0[3:0] first (DAT3 = MSB), then byte 0 low nibble. Each DAT line carries 1 bit per CLK edge.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Host drives CLK at all times during an active transaction. Host issues every command on CMD; card responds within Ncr CLK cycles. Data on DAT is gated by the command and only flows after the response. DAT0 LOW signals card busy.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Card responses depend on host commands. DAT direction (host→card for write, card→host for read) depends on the most recent data command. Busy on DAT0 holds host off until programming complete.

handshake_pairs.name: CMD_REQ_RESP
handshake_pairs.rule: Host transmits 48-bit command; card responds in Ncr cycles with R1/R6/R7 (48 bits) or R2 (136 bits) or R3 (48 bits, no CRC).

handshake_pairs.name: DAT_BLOCK_READ
handshake_pairs.rule: Card transmits Start bit + 512 B + CRC16 + End bit after R1 in Sending-data state.

handshake_pairs.name: DAT_BLOCK_WRITE
handshake_pairs.rule: Host transmits Start bit + 512 B + CRC16 + End bit after R1 in Receive-data state; card returns Data Response Token on DAT0.

handshake_pairs.name: DAT0_BUSY
handshake_pairs.rule: Card pulls DAT0 LOW during Programming; releases HIGH when complete.

handshake_pairs.name: VOLTAGE_SWITCH
handshake_pairs.rule: After CMD11, card pulls CMD/DAT0..DAT3 LOW; host stops CLK + switches VDDIO; card releases HIGH within 1 ms.
